tools.name: domains__availability
tools.description: Registered or available, straight from the TLD registry. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: domains__facts
tools.description: Registrar, created, expiry, age, status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: domains__dns
tools.description: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME and CAA records (or one type). A few free samples a day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: domains__ip-owner
tools.description: Network, organisation, range, country and abuse email for an IP, from the regional internet registry. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: domains__dmca-agent
tools.description: Published DMCA / abuse contact (email or form) for a major platform, host, CDN or registrar. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: domains__abuse-contacts
tools.description: Everyone to send an abuse or takedown report to for a site: platform agent, hosting network (+ abuse email, CDN flag) and registrar. A few free samples a day, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: domains__email-auth
tools.description: MX, SPF and DMARC for a domain, the mail provider, issues found and a grade. A few free samples a day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: domains__ideas
tools.description: Rule-based domain candidates for a keyword: exact, stopword-free, hyphenated, prefixed and suffixed, across chosen TLDs, with a trademark flag. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: ip-geolocation__lookup
tools.description: Country, continent, EU membership, network block, ASN, organisation and hosting flag for one IP. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: ip-geolocation__country
tools.description: Country and continent for one IP. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.0005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: ip-geolocation__asn
tools.description: ASN, organisation and hosting flag for one IP. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.0005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: ip-geolocation__batch
tools.description: Full lookup for up to 100 IPs in one call. A few free samples a day, then $0.02 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: seo__robots-check
tools.description: Whether a crawler (Googlebot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot…) may fetch a URL, the rule that decided it, and declared sitemaps. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: seo__page-audit
tools.description: Title, meta, H1, canonical, noindex, hreflang, structured data, OG tags, word count, links, alt text, issues and a score. A few free samples a day, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: seo__links
tools.description: Internal and external links on a page with anchor text and nofollow flags. A few free samples a day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: seo__keyword-intent
tools.description: Classify a search keyword as transactional, commercial, navigational or informational. A few free samples a day, then $0.0005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: validators__imei
tools.description: Validate an IMEI (length + Luhn) and split TAC, serial and check digit. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.0005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: validators__vin
tools.description: VIN format, check digit, WMI and model-year candidates. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.0005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: validators__iban
tools.description: IBAN mod-97 checksum and country length; UK sort code extracted. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.0005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: validators__uk-phone
tools.description: Classify a UK number (mobile, landline, freephone, premium…) and format as E.164. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.0005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: validators__uk-postcode
tools.description: Validate and normalise UK postcode format; split outward/inward codes. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.0005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: validators__email
tools.description: Email syntax, whether the domain accepts mail, disposable and role-account flags. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: web__read
tools.description: Main content of a public web page as clean markdown, with title, byline, published date, canonical URL, language, word count and links. A few free samples a day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: web__unfurl
tools.description: Open Graph and Twitter card data, favicon, theme colour, JSON-LD types, RSS/Atom feeds and sitemaps for a URL. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: web__url-safety
tools.description: Warning signs for a URL: redirect chain and final destination, TLS certificate, domain age, punycode and brand-lookalike tricks, bare IPs, and security-header grade. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "web" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seo__robots-check, web__read, web__unfurl · Private data: domains__dns, domains__dmca-agent, domains__abuse-contacts · Public sink: domains__ip-owner, domains__dmca-agent, domains__abuse-contacts, domains__email-auth, validators__email · Destructive: validators__vin, validators__uk-phone, validators__uk-postcode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: seo__robots-check, web__read, web__unfurl · Private data: domains__dns, domains__dmca-agent, domains__abuse-contacts · Public sink: domains__ip-owner, domains__dmca-agent, domains__abuse-contacts, domains__email-auth, validators__email · Destructive: validators__vin, validators__uk-phone, validators__uk-postcode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
